# 加法范畴　`def.additive-category`　·　续页（第 4 页）
[在星图里打开](../#n=def.additive-category)　·　第 1 页 [nodes/def.additive-category.md](./def.additive-category.md)　·　上一页 [nodes/def.additive-category.3.md](./def.additive-category.3.md)

## 它能推出什么 / 谁在用它（续）
- 被 [`def.pre-abelian-category`](../nodes/def.pre-abelian-category.md) 预阿贝尔范畴 用
- 被 [`def.cochain-complex`](../nodes/def.cochain-complex.md) 上链复形 用
- 被 [`def.bicomplex`](../nodes/def.bicomplex.md) 双复形 用
- 被 [`prop.adjoint-additive`](../nodes/prop.adjoint-additive.md) 伴随函子都加法 用
- 被 [`def.kernel-cokernel`](../nodes/def.kernel-cokernel.md) 核与余核 用
- 被 [`prop.additive-iff-preserves-biproduct`](../nodes/prop.additive-iff-preserves-biproduct.md) 加法函子的刻画 用
- 被 [`prop.simplicial-to-chain`](../nodes/prop.simplicial-to-chain.md) 单纯对象给出链复形 用
